name: Semantic Translation to Serial Spans
description: Replaces standard aggregation terms ("sum", "total time", "active duration") with the concept of a "serial span" within a sequential chain. By framing the bottlenecks as properties of purely sequential chains (Job-specific and Server-specific), models relying on verbatim pattern matching of explicit summation cues will struggle to map the text to `p1 + p2 > T` and `sum(p_c) > T`, while reasoning models will correctly deduce that operations in a serial chain add up.
